v5 roadmap has NO row to belong to. Listed here so the guard can enforce every commit
from here on without inventing checklist rows (AGENTS.md forbids inserting rows) and
without marking an unrelated row as evidence.
These entries are NOT evidence, NOT verification and NOT a statement that the work is
complete. Never add a sha here to silence a real drift, and never extend this file for
work done after 2026-09-10 — sync the real row instead (npm run gate:status).
